next.reason: 1985: 'OPEN { INPUT {file-name-1} … | OUTPUT {file-name-2} … | I-O {file-name-3} … | EXTEND {file-name-4} … } …'; 2023: 'OPEN {{INPUT|OUTPUT|I-O|EXTEND} [ sharing-phrase ] [ retry-phrase ] { file-name-1 [ WITH NO REWIND ] } …} …'. Same four repeatable open modes, but the 2023 format adds optional sharing-phrase, retry-phrase and WITH NO REWIND, so it accepts OPEN statements the 1985 format refuses.
